scope: Focused tests for lossless compact storage of PublicObservationIndexV2 rows.

fixture.shape: Fixed synthetic BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT observations, two BTC contract revisions, TRADE and AGG_TRADE events, actual and reconstructed availability, deterministic clocks and archive chunks.

required_invariants.description: Newly archived PublicObservationIndexV2 rows may use compact storage while get_artifact, get_artifact_metadata_by_refs, artifact_entries, and artifact_entries_by_types expose the exact original artifact type, ref, content hash, created/available times, and decoded metadata. Metadata includes exact source fields, archive chunk identity, and publication chronology.
After closing and reopening OpsRepository read-only, compact rows have the same exact domain values and metadata as before restart.
Pre-existing plain artifact_index JSON rows remain readable alongside compact rows through point, batch, and typed repository reads.
Corrupt compact metadata identity/checksum is surfaced as an error by point, batch, and typed reads; it is not silently skipped, replaced by defaults, or treated as a missing artifact.

public_archive_history_entries preserves exact revision, optional full-key scope, event types, actual availability cutoff, reconstructed replay cutoff, and deterministic receipt ordering including identity ties.

implementation_state.evidence: The checked-in compact locator path handles PublicStreamFrameIndexV1, PublicStreamTradeObservationIndexV1, and PublicStreamSourceHealthV1; PublicObservationIndexV2 remains selected from artifact_index metadata JSON in the repository query implementation. The new tests therefore define expected behavior and may fail until the compact public observation implementation is added.

change_boundary: Tests and this contract document only; production sources and existing tests were not modified by this task.
